qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md:13,19,21 (negative needs a successful control; dead feature must not earn credit)
qc/runs/kittle-2026-10-09-r3/raw-evidence-index.json (scope header: scripted golden only, no configured judge run)
evidence: Most negative legs are well paired inside their own criterion, and the functional prompt states the rule globally (scored/functional/prompt.md:45-46 'Every refusal pairs with a success of the same kind on an eligible target, in the same criterion or an earlier one'). Paired examples: render gate pairs pre-sign-in privacy and wrong password with Gwen's successful sign-in (gates/render/judge.toml:26-30); signin_and_client_scope Part B has an explicit M-11 post positive control before the M-12 replays (functional/judge.toml:47-48); wall_mentions_and_links pairs Dev's 'not available' preview/link with Harriet's working preview/link and Dev's absent JUDGE-M1 with his present JUDGE-M2 (lines 72-74); wall_added_live pairs the refused post replay with Sian's earlier successful post and the refused self-lift with Harriet's working lift (83-88); deleted_and_expired pairs 'gone' with surviving reply, search hits for 'Clause 14 noted'/'JUDGE-X1', transcript placeholder, and the one-second-younger message (111-119); timer_changes pairs not-available versions/search/transcript with the recorded positive version list, 'executor' search hit and executor transcript entry (129-131); hold_scope_and_release has an explicit delete positive control and the On-hold mark on H1 vs H0/H1C/H2 (145-151); edits, unread (deleted-not-counted vs count 2), sent_once (D2 control), search_and_transcript ('notice recieved' none vs 'notice received and filed' found) and persistence ('Persist gone' none vs 'Persist child' found) are paired; polish refusal_in_place pairs wrong-password reason with a correct sign-in (polish/judge.toml:62). Defect: wall_every_route (functional/judge.toml:58-63) records Sian's M-12 transcript request but its positive control only covers thread and search: 'Sian sees JUDGE-W0 in the thread and her search finds it (positive control)'. Legs 3-4 then credit the transcript route by absence ('the thread and transcript answers are a plain not-available'; 'Opening the M-12 transcript address directly in Dev's browser shows not-available') with no in-criterion transcript success. The prompt's 'or an earlier one' fallback does not cover it: the first transcript success appears in deleted_and_expired (criterion 6, later), and judge mode is 'individual' (functional/judge.toml:6), so each criterion is a separate session that cannot reuse another criterion's observation anyway (REVIEW_POLICY.md:19 'Reuse an observed fact, not another row's pass flag'). Lesser instance of the same gap: hold_scope_and_release leg 6 (line 150) 'searching "Insurer letter" finds nothing' has no search success inside that criterion (bounded, because the thread disappearance is the primary observable). No configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope), so nothing here is measured; this is a rubric-design finding.
counterexample: A submission whose transcript server route denies everyone (e.g. an access check that always fails and returns a 'not available' page, or an SPA catch-all that renders 'not available' for unknown routes) but whose thread, search and list walls work: Sian's thread/search control passes, Dev's transcript replay and direct transcript address show not-available, and wall_every_route (weight 2.0) is awarded including its transcript-route leg although the transcript never worked for anyone. The dead route earns the wall credit for doing nothing; only the later search_and_transcript criterion catches the dead transcript.
suggested_fix: In wall_every_route add 'and Sian's M-12 transcript shows JUDGE-W0' to the positive control (and to the Fails clause); optionally in hold_scope_and_release leg 6 add a same-criterion search hit (e.g. searching 'Hold child JUDGE-H1' finds it) beside 'Insurer letter finds nothing'.
